summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Architecture and Management Frameworks Training Course. Learn essential strategies for effective data management.
lede: Data architecture is the coordinated design of data structures, flows, ownership, metadata, and controls. For professionals who design, govern, integrate, secure, or sponsor enterprise data, this course covers assessing current capabilities and turning gaps into sequenced initiatives. Learners practice modeling information flows, defining metadata and data quality controls, and developing target-state architecture blueprints and roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This data architecture and management course is designed for professionals who create, govern, integrate, secure, or sponsor enterprise data structures and flows.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: Basic exposure to organizational data, systems, analytics, governance, or architecture. Programming: No coding is required. Optional facilitator demonstrations may show how catalog and quality tools automate selected tasks. Equipment: Bring a laptop capable of running a browser and standard office software. Archi installation is recommended for the modeling lab, while diagrams.net provides a browser-based alternative. Advanced content depth: AI-assisted metadata, automated quality monitoring, and digital control monitoring are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels rather than technical engineering depth.
